preconditions.note: The local readiness verdict gates whether this protocol should be executed. NOT_READY does not make the protocol wrong; it makes running it premature.

stages.name: environment smoke test
stages.purpose: Prove the harness runs at all before anything expensive depends on it: import the package, run the test suite, confirm the measurement lock and the allocator cap behave as they do locally.
stages.produces: a pass/fail record and the environment fingerprint
stages.abort_if: the suite does not pass on the target machine
stages.cost_if_skipped: an hour of allocation spent discovering a packaging problem

stages.name: topology verification
stages.purpose: Establish which GPUs are actually connected how. nvidia-smi topo -m, NVLink presence and width per pair, NUMA affinity, and whether the eight devices are one NVSwitch domain or two quads.
stages.produces: a topology map recorded in the artifact
stages.abort_if: the topology differs from the one the protocol assumes, in which case the grid of world sizes is re-derived and the change is recorded as a declared deviation before measurement
stages.cost_if_skipped: fitting one fabric model across two fabrics, which is the error the local campaign's inter_node flag exists to prevent

stages.name: device and allocator verification
stages.purpose: Confirm memory capacity per device, that the allocator cap installs, and that an over-large allocation raises rather than falling back. This is the check that made local feasibility measurable at all.
stages.produces: ProbeConfig with cap_installed true, per device
stages.abort_if: the cap cannot be installed on any device
stages.cost_if_skipped: feasibility measurements that mean 'eventually returned' rather than 'fits'

stages.name: fabric identification
stages.purpose: Determine, by measurement rather than by assumption, which transport each world size actually traverses: intra-node NVLink, intra-node PCIe fallback, or inter-node. A four-rank group with one rank per node runs at IB speed, not NVLink speed.
stages.produces: a transport label per (world size, rank placement)
stages.abort_if: a group's transport cannot be identified
stages.cost_if_skipped: pricing an inter-node collective at NVLink bandwidth, which flatters every sharding recommendation that depends on it

stages.name: communication calibration
stages.purpose: Run the dense campaign grid, unchanged, against NCCL on the real fabric. Same sizes, same oversampled regions, same two passes, same repeats.
stages.produces: raw PointRecords, per collective per world per pass
stages.abort_if: peak reproducibility fails, which is reported rather than worked around

stages.name: parameter quality gates
stages.purpose: Family selection under every registered estimator, stratified k-fold cross-validation, worst-regime acceptance. Identical code to the local campaign; only the data differs.
stages.produces: a ParameterVerdict per group and a coverage matrix
stages.abort_if: no group is accepted, which ends the campaign honestly rather than loosening the gate

stages.name: model freeze
stages.purpose: Freeze the accepted communication parameters into a Fabric. Rejected and diagnostic parameters are recorded and remain unusable.
stages.produces: a sealed Fabric with parameter provenance
stages.abort_if: any rejected parameter is reachable as a model input

stages.name: Thrust I prediction generation
stages.purpose: Run the simulator with the frozen memory model and the frozen communication model, over the registered sharding grid, and extract the predicted loss regions.
stages.produces: a predicted loss map and its regions
stages.abort_if: the memory or communication model is not frozen

stages.name: prediction lock
stages.purpose: Seal the prediction: hash it, record the hash, and stop. This is the step that makes the next one a test rather than a fit.
stages.abort_if: the prediction is not sealed before measurement begins
stages.cost_if_skipped: a comparison that cannot distinguish a good model from a well-chosen narrative, which is the whole failure this project is about

stages.name: independent 8-GPU measurement
stages.purpose: Measure the registered sharding grid under torchrun on all eight devices, with GPU exclusivity enforced and the registered replicate count.
stages.abort_if: the measurement shares hardware with another job

stages.name: measured loss-region extraction
stages.purpose: Extract loss regions from the measurement using the same extractor, at the registered MDE and FDR level.
stages.abort_if: the design check reports the sweep could not have declared a loss

stages.name: prediction against measurement
stages.purpose: Score the sealed prediction: region overlap, boundary displacement, false wins, false losses, dangerous-error score, per-regime error.
stages.produces: the calibration report and the final Thrust I claim
stages.abort_if: the prediction hash does not match what was sealed at stage 9

transferability.statement: No value measured locally is used here. The local campaign ran gloo over shared memory on one host; it cannot produce NVLink or InfiniBand parameters and none of its fits is copied into an A100 Fabric. What transfers is the method: grid construction, estimator families, selection rule, coverage criteria and the readiness gate, all unchanged.
what_it_does_not_establish: that Thrust I communication is calibrated

ordering_is_binding: Stages 8 and 9 run before stage 10. A prediction produced after seeing the measurement is not a prediction, and no result from an out-of-order run is admissible.
abort_policy: Each stage names its own abort condition. Aborting is a successful outcome of the stage: the allocation is expensive and a campaign that stops at stage 2 with a recorded topology surprise is worth more than one that proceeds on a wrong assumption.
